description: This file implements a data access layer for managing notes, providing methods to create, retrieve, list, update, and delete Note objects using SQLAlchemy's asynchronous API.

classes.name: NotesRepository
classes.description: A repository class for CRUD operations on Note objects.

methods.name: None __init__(self, session: AsyncSession)
methods.description: Initializes the repository with an async database session.

methods.name: Note create(self, title: str, content: str)
methods.description: Creates a new Note with the given title and content, saves it to the database, and returns the Note instance.

methods.name: Optional[Note] get(self, note_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a Note by its ID, returning None if not found.

methods.name: List[Note] list(self)
methods.description: Retrieves all notes ordered by creation date descending.

methods.name: Note update(self, note: Note, *, title: Optional[str], content: Optional[str])
methods.description: Updates the title and/or content of an existing Note and refreshes it from the database.

methods.name: None delete(self, note: Note)
methods.description: Deletes the specified Note from the database.

ctags.name: create
ctags.pattern: /^    async def create(self, title: str, content: str) -> Note:$/

ctags.name: delete
ctags.pattern: /^    async def delete(self, note: Note) -> None:$/

ctags.name: get
ctags.pattern: /^    async def get(self, note_id: int) -> Optional[Note]:$/

ctags.name: update
ctags.pattern: /^    async def update(self, note: Note, *, title: Optional[str], content: Optional[str]) -> Note:$/
ctags.signature: (self, note: Note, *, title: Optional[str], content: Optional[str])
